notesStmt.note: "Fancies at Navesink," including the poem "Last of Ebb," was first published in The Nineteenth Century magazine in August 1885, meaning that this mansucript was written sometime prior to that date, likely in the early 1880s.
These draft lines contain vague similarities to several of the poems in the "Fancies at Navesink" cluster of November Boughs (1888), particularly "Last of Ebb, and Daylight Waning."
